original.statement: In the SecretStore external-secrets.io/v1beta1 schema, spec.provider.fake.data[].value becomes required (items required changes from ["key"] to ["key","value"]), so SecretStores omitting it are rejected.

decision.reason: [ev-210dbd3942ad] shows that from 0.15.0 to 0.16.0, the required list for spec.provider.fake.data items in the secretstores.external-secrets.io v1beta1 schema changed from ["key"] to ["key","value"]. The semvalidate.crd validator also confirmed that this field becomes required. The proposed exposure matches the environments that get rejected: a v1beta1 SecretStore with fake-provider data entries where value is missing. The ClusterSecretStore change [ev-9fd85560a485] is a separate subject, so leaving it out of this item's condition is correct.
